description: A life insurance policy statement, in-force illustration summary, or annual policy statement showing cash value and coverage details. Used to verify life-insurance asset value.

insurer_name.instruction: The name of the life insurance company that issued the policy.

policyholder_name.instruction: The full name of the person who owns the policy.

insured_name.instruction: The full name of the person whose life is insured under the policy, if different from the policyholder.

policy_number.instruction: The unique policy number assigned by the insurer.

policy_type.instruction: The type of life insurance policy, such as term, whole, or universal life.

death_benefit.instruction: The face value or death benefit amount of the policy.

cash_surrender_value.instruction: The current cash surrender value of the policy, if applicable.

premium_amount.instruction: The premium amount owed or paid for the policy.

premium_frequency.instruction: How often the premium is paid, such as monthly, quarterly, or annually.

statement_date.instruction: The statement or policy anniversary date shown on the document. YYYY-MM-DD format.
